findingsForCoreOwner.finding: The pinned nats.go processTransientError invokes the async error handler with nil subscription. The sub != nil guard misses real snapshot permission refusals; the permanent refusal fixture returns only after its two-second timeout (2.06 seconds including fixture setup).
findingsForCoreOwner.nextAction: Recognize the exact snapshot denial using the pinned client error shape or its supported subscription permission mechanism, preserve independent INFO failures, and add a prompt refusal timing assertion. No permission bypass was observed.
